messages:
maya: Heads-up — live all-hands stream: backup recorder (recorder-2) dropped frames and audio went out for ~20s. We're on main feed but backup is flaky. Can ops push the quick switch plan?
jon: On it. Can you confirm if recorder-2 is on-prem or ec2?
maya: On-prem in room C, rack 3. Samir was checking levels earlier.
samir: I'm on the way. Quick check: recorder-2 disk at 92% — might be log churn. If it reboots it could free up space but risk losing buffer. Suggest flipping the OBS RTMP fallback to recorder-1 for redundancy.
ashley: Agree. Flip now and keep main on-air. Also can someone DM Arjun to delay the roadmap slides by 2 mins?
ops-bot: Deploy notice: routing-switcher v2.3 deployed 18s ago to staging.
jon: Command to flip RTMP temporarily:
```
kubectl -n streaming set image deployment/routing-switcher routing-switcher=ghcr.io/rw-inference/routing-switcher:v2.3
kubectl -n streaming scale deployment/routing-switcher --replicas=3
```
samir: Doing manual hot-switch now: switching OBS output to recorder-1. @maya confirm when you see stable levels.
maya: Levels back, no glitching on backup. :thumbsup: Please keep an eye on captions — the transcript stalled during the outage.
arjun: I'm holding slides. We'll skip the 1st two roadmap bullets and move to Q&A if needed.
ashley: Thx. @jon can you add a short sticky note in console: "backup recorder disk full — replace drive after meeting"?
jon: Done. Created ticket INF-4523 and pinned note in console UI.
maya: Recording path note: downstream clipper uses /mnt/recorder1/clips — new clip appears after 30s buffer.
samir: Logged extractor errors, tail:
```
[2026-03-23T14:12:05Z] extractor ERROR: write failed: no space left on device
```
maya: Post-meeting action: replace drive in rack 3, and run a rolling cleanup job across recorders to trim logs older than 48h. I'll add to action items.
ashley: Great, thanks team. We'll announce 1-min delay to attendees.
ops-bot: Reminder: incident commander set to @jon for this thread.
